summary: At its meeting on November 25, 2019, the Board delegated to the Chair the recruitment process for the position of President of the Toronto Parking Authority and requested that the Chair update the Board on the process as needed. The Chair of the Board will provide an update to the Board during its meeting on November 3, 2020, regarding the search process for a President.
decided: The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
